Build LFQData from wide matrices

Source: R/tidyMS_reshaping.R
lfqdata_from_wide.Rd

The inverse of [tidy_to_wide_config()]: feature x sample matrices, their row annotation and their sample annotation back to long-format LFQData. Row `i` of every matrix belongs to row `i` of `rowdata`; matrix column names are the sample names.

Usage

lfqdata_from_wide(values, rowdata, annotation, config, prefix = "ms")

Arguments

values

a matrix (features in rows, samples in columns), stored under `config$get_response()`, or a named list of such matrices with identical dimensions and column names; list names are the value columns

rowdata

data.frame with one row per matrix row and the hierarchy key columns; the isotope label column is optional and set to `"light"` if absent

annotation

data.frame with one row per sample: `config$sample_name` plus the file name and factor columns

config

AnalysisConfiguration describing the result

prefix

prefix passed to [LFQData]

Value

LFQData

See also

Other LFQData: AggregateLimpa, AggregateMedpolish, AggregateRlm, AggregateTopN, AggregatorBase, LFQData, LFQDataPlotter, LFQDataStats, LFQDataSummariser, LFQDataToSummarizedExperiment()

Examples

dd <- prolfqua::sim_lfq_data_peptide_config()
#> creating sampleName from file_name column
lfqdata <- prolfqua::LFQData$new(dd$data, dd$config)
wide <- tidy_to_wide_config(lfqdata, as.matrix = TRUE)
back <- lfqdata_from_wide(wide$data, wide$rowdata, wide$annotation, lfqdata$get_config())
stopifnot(nrow(back$data_long()) == nrow(lfqdata$data_long()))
